title: Lichen Drift/Apply Report
description: Machine-readable output of `check` and `apply` (--format json). Mirrors the ReconciliationPlan/Report entity in data-model.md.

snapshot.description: How the evaluated content was sourced: worktree or index.

pass.description: True only if no file is WrongLicense/CopyrightMismatch/MissingHeader/Uncovered/Unreadable, no unresolved conflict, and no blocked license text (FR-012a, FR-025, SC-009). For apply dry-run, true means projected success. Lint additionally requires a complete license-text inventory.

partial.description: Apply wrote files and the tool itself also failed (FR-021).

complete.description: False when final verification did not run and the report rests on planned data.

before_pass.description: Apply only: gate state before apply ran.

projected_pass.description: Apply dry-run only: whether executing the planned writes is projected to pass.

copyright_mismatch.description: Files whose license matches but whose copyright policy is unsatisfied.

unreadable.description: Files skipped as non-UTF-8/unsafe to edit; counts as failure (FR-025).

conflicts.description: Files with an unresolved equal-specificity rule conflict (FR-022).

contradictions.description: Files left internally contradictory, e.g. by additive apply (FR-020).

declared.description: Declared SPDX expression from the matched rule or default.

actual.description: Detected SPDX expression (in-file header or out-of-band).

actual_source.description: Where the actual license was detected (FR-003a).

applied.description: False on dry-run or when this file's write failed (FR-021).

change.description: Present for apply (or dry-run preview). Copyright preserved by default (SC-004).

metadata_origins.description: Contributing out-of-band tables, shallowest document first (FR-003a).

coverage.description: Lint only: sorted repo-relative covered paths evaluated for REUSE validation (REUSE-ignored files excluded). Compared against the reference tool's file list in the differential suite.

diagnostics.description: Structured diagnostics, sorted by path, then code.

writes.description: Independent write records: one per planned/applied/failed/blocked write. Never joined to file states; a metadata patch covers many files (FR-021).

path.description: Destination written (the document itself for metadata patches).

before_text.description: Exact current bytes as text, for text being written.

after_text.description: Exact installed bytes as text; absent when unknown until execution.

message.description: Reason for failed/blocked writes (fetch URL, missing id).

spdx_list_version.description: Version of the embedded SPDX license list this binary carries (FR-028).

unused.description: Present but never referenced (project-wide lint finding only).

unrecognized.description: LICENSES/ entries naming no recognizable license.

missing_extension.description: Recognized ids kept in extensionless files.
